digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler mutation payload typing and shadow replay
propositions: Implement approved ADR 0107 direction/action payload union types and thread through planner/coordinator boundaries to effect-free adapter projection without modifying production write route.

Build versioned deterministic corpus from synthetic tickets and scrubbed store snapshot covering create/update/delete/probe/conflict, links/comments/labels/status, failures, and edge cases without credentials or live bindings.

Drive legacy and typed planning/serialization over identical observations and capture normalized intent/outcome traces; compare ordering, fields, identity scopes, diagnostics, follow-ons, suppression, and retry dispositions.
Execute shadow comparator with failing effect spies on Jira transport, ticket-store write, subprocess, clock sleep, and network seams to prove zero unintended side effects.

Document four approved intentional deltas between legacy and typed payload shapes (inbound_conflict_reason, outbound_delete/probe_stray_fields, outbound_update_empty, inbound_delete/probe_dead_by_design) as named reject scenarios with rationale.
Verify route census that production dispatch entry points remain byte-identical and unmodified, and no shadow-only module becomes depended upon by production write paths.
